params.name: content_id
params.description: ID of Content, for example, the application/vnd.pryon.content.id attachment from the Exchange API.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number within the content ID, for example, the application/vnd.pryon.start_page attachment from the Exchange API.

params.name: uncompressed
params.description: The default of False indicates the image data is compressed; True indicates the image data should not be compressed.
